title: Enable Game Mode
description: Sets the current-user Game Mode preference.
name: AllowAutoGameMode

title: Disable Xbox Game Bar capture
description: Turns off background game capture.
name: AppCaptureEnabled

title: Disable Game DVR policy
description: Disables Game DVR capture policy for this user.
name: GameDVR_Enabled

title: Disable mouse acceleration
description: Uses raw pointer movement by disabling Enhance Pointer Precision.
name: MouseSpeed

title: Set mouse threshold 1
description: Removes first Windows pointer acceleration threshold.
name: MouseThreshold1

title: Set mouse threshold 2
description: Removes second Windows pointer acceleration threshold.
name: MouseThreshold2

title: Disable background capture
description: Turns off background recording preference.
name: HistoricalCaptureEnabled

title: Set Game Bar presence writer off
description: Stops Game Bar presence writer behavior.
name: ShowStartupPanel

title: Disable Game Bar tips
description: Hides first-run Game Bar prompts.
name: UseNexusForGameBarEnabled

title: Disable fullscreen optimization behavior
description: Sets per-user compatibility behavior flags. Some legacy games may need the opposite setting.
name: GameDVR_FSEBehaviorMode

title: Honor per-user fullscreen flags
description: Enables Windows to honor per-user fullscreen optimization flags.
name: GameDVR_HonorUserFSEBehaviorMode

title: Disable fullscreen optimization compatibility behavior
description: Sets the Windows game configuration compatibility behavior flag.
name: GameDVR_DXGIHonorFSEWindowsCompatible

title: Disable Xbox Live Auth Manager at startup
description: Stops the service from starting automatically. Xbox sign-in and connected games may be affected.

title: Disable Xbox Live Game Save at startup
description: Stops the service from starting automatically. Cloud saves may be affected.

title: Disable Xbox Live Networking at startup
description: Stops the service from starting automatically. Xbox networking features may be affected.

title: Disable Xbox Accessory service at startup
description: Stops the service from starting automatically. Xbox accessory features may be affected.

title: Request hardware-accelerated GPU scheduling
description: Requests HAGS where the Windows build, GPU and driver support it. The system may ignore this preference; restart to apply.
name: HwSchMode

title: Disable Sticky Keys shortcut
description: Disables the five-press Shift shortcut that can interrupt games. Sticky Keys accessibility remains available from Settings.
name: Flags

title: Disable GameInput service at startup
description: Stops GameInput from starting automatically. Xbox controllers and games that use newer Windows input APIs may stop working.

title: Timer resolution policy
description: Review-only: Timer resolution is requested by running processes through a runtime API; there is no reliable persistent global registry switch.

title: Global fullscreen optimizations
description: Review-only: Windows compatibility flags are per executable and can change game behavior. The library exposes the reversible per-user game-configuration flags separately.

title: Per-game fullscreen optimizations
description: Review-only: Requires selecting and backing up a specific game executable compatibility entry.

title: Disable Windows key
description: Review-only: Requires a keyboard-wide scancode map and restart, which can disable essential shortcuts across all apps.

title: GPU driver low-latency mode
description: Review-only: Driver controls differ across NVIDIA, AMD, and Intel and are not exposed through one stable Windows setting.

title: Per-game network priority
description: Review-only: Needs game-specific process or traffic rules and can interfere with anti-cheat or VPN routing.

title: Raw input policy
description: Review-only: Raw input is selected by applications; there is no supported system-wide toggle.

title: Variable refresh rate policy
description: Review-only: Depends on GPU, display, driver, and per-app capability.

title: Disable power throttling
description: Disables Windows power throttling policy. Higher power use possible.
name: PowerThrottlingOff

title: Set system responsiveness for games
description: Sets MMCSS SystemResponsiveness to 10 (Windows default intent is multimedia reservation).
name: SystemResponsiveness

title: Enable long path support
description: Allows long paths for aware applications.
name: LongPathsEnabled

title: Set SysMain service to manual
description: Leaves SysMain available on demand without automatically starting it. Startup behavior varies by Windows build.

title: Activate Ultimate Performance power plan
description: Switches to the built-in Ultimate Performance scheme. Saves and restores the previously active plan; may increase power use and heat.

title: Keep all CPU cores unparked
description: Sets the minimum unparked core percentage to 100 for the active plan. This can increase idle power and heat.

title: Allow all cores to remain unparked
description: Sets the maximum unparked core percentage to 100 for the active plan. This can increase idle power and heat.

title: Set minimum processor state to 100%
description: Keeps the CPU at its minimum performance state while plugged in; leaves battery minimum at 5%. Restores previous AC and DC values when disabled. This can increase heat and power use.

title: Set maximum processor state to 100%
description: Allows full processor performance on AC and battery power. Restores prior power-plan values when disabled; higher performance can increase heat and battery use.

title: Disable USB selective suspend
description: Prevents Windows from suspending idle USB devices on the active power plan. Microsoft recommends leaving this enabled for battery efficiency; turn this on only to troubleshoot device dropouts.

title: Disable CPU C-states
description: Review-only: C-states are firmware and processor controls; changing them generically can raise heat and power use.

title: Disable processor idle states
description: Review-only: Processor idle states are platform-managed firmware behavior and are not safely controlled as a generic Windows toggle.

title: Disable dynamic tick
description: Review-only: Changes boot configuration and can disrupt timers, power management, or virtualization.

title: Disable HPET
description: Review-only: Boot-level timer selection varies by platform and can reduce performance or stability.

title: Disable CPU frequency scaling
description: Review-only: Windows and processor firmware jointly manage frequency scaling; min/max state controls are available instead.

title: Disable thermal throttling
description: Review-only: Thermal protection must remain enabled to protect the CPU and system.

title: Disable Nagle algorithm (global TCP)
description: Sets TCP_NODELAY only at the system TCP parameters level; per-adapter tuning is not supported here.
name: TcpNoDelay

title: Set TCP delayed ACK frequency
description: Sets the system TCP delayed ACK frequency. Adapter-specific overrides may take precedence.
name: TcpAckFrequency

title: Disable network throttling
description: Sets multimedia network throttling index to disabled sentinel.
name: NetworkThrottlingIndex

title: Set multimedia system profile games priority
description: Sets the system profile games priority to a common default multimedia setting.
name: Priority

title: Set multimedia GPU priority
description: Sets the system profile games GPU priority.
name: GPU Priority

title: Set multimedia games scheduling category
description: Sets the system profile games scheduling category.
name: Scheduling Category

title: Disable Nagle algorithm on network adapters
description: Sets TCP_NODELAY and delayed-ACK frequency to 1 on each installed TCP/IP adapter interface. Saves the original per-adapter values; throughput or compatibility may change.

title: Set DNS over HTTPS
description: Review-only: Resolver and DoH support vary by Windows build and adapter; the current DNS selector changes ordinary DNS servers with exact restore.

title: TCP autotuning level
description: Review-only: Global TCP stack changes can reduce throughput or compatibility; the default adapts to the connection.

title: ECN capability
description: Review-only: ECN support depends on the network path and can affect connectivity.

title: RSS queue tuning
description: Review-only: Queue counts and processor affinity depend on the installed network adapter and driver.

title: Disable QoS reservation
description: Review-only: There is no universal bandwidth reservation switch that improves latency across Windows versions.

title: Disable Teredo
description: Review-only: Can break Xbox party/chat and applications that rely on Teredo IPv6 tunneling.

title: Disable ISATAP
description: Review-only: Can break networks that rely on ISATAP IPv6 transition services.

title: Disable 6to4
description: Review-only: Can break networks that rely on 6to4 IPv6 transition services.

title: Set MTU
description: Review-only: Requires a per-adapter, link-specific value; an incorrect MTU can break connectivity.

title: Disable network power saving
description: Review-only: Power-management controls are vendor-specific adapter settings.

title: Set interface metric
description: Review-only: Needs the user to choose which adapter should take precedence; a global default would change routing.

title: Disable IPv6 transition technology
description: Review-only: Would alter multiple connectivity mechanisms and can break VPN or IPv6 paths.

title: Limit diagnostic data to required
description: Sets the Windows diagnostic data policy. Edition and management policy can override this.
name: AllowTelemetry

title: Disable advertising ID
description: Disables personalized ads for current user.
name: Enabled

title: Disable tailored experiences
description: Turns off consumer tailored experiences.
name: TailoredExperiencesWithDiagnosticDataEnabled

title: Disable feedback notifications
description: Stops Windows feedback prompts.
name: NumberOfSIUFInPeriod

title: Disable activity publishing
description: Disables activity feed publishing for current user.
name: PublishUserActivities

title: Disable activity upload
description: Disables activity upload policy.
name: UploadUserActivities

title: Disable consumer features
description: Turns off Windows consumer experience suggestions policy.
name: DisableWindowsConsumerFeatures

title: Disable app suggestions
description: Turns off suggested app notifications for current user.
name: SystemPaneSuggestionsEnabled

title: Disable lock screen suggestions
description: Turns off lock screen content suggestions.
name: RotatingLockScreenEnabled

title: Disable silent app installs
description: Disables suggested app installs for current user.
name: SilentInstalledAppsEnabled

title: Disable advertising ID policy
description: Disables advertising ID policy.
name: DisabledByGroupPolicy

title: Disable Bing web search in Start
description: Disables web search suggestions in Start menu search.
name: DisableWebSearch

title: Disable search cloud content
description: Disables cloud content suggestions in Windows Search.
name: IsMSACloudSearchEnabled

title: Disable work account search content
description: Disables organization cloud content suggestions in Search.
name: IsAADCloudSearchEnabled

title: Disable recent document tracking
description: Stops Windows tracking recent documents for the current user.
name: NoRecentDocsHistory

title: Disable recent item jump lists
description: Stops Windows tracking recent items in jump lists for the current user.
name: NoRecentDocsNetHood

title: Disable app launch tracking
description: Stops Windows tracking app launches for suggestions.
name: Start_TrackProgs

title: Disable document tracking
description: Stops Windows tracking recently opened documents.
name: Start_TrackDocs

title: Disable Remote Registry at startup
description: Prevents the Remote Registry service from starting automatically; remote administration workflows may need it.

title: Disable Windows Error Reporting at startup
description: Prevents automatic start of Windows Error Reporting. Crash reporting may be unavailable.

title: Disable Connected User Experiences and Telemetry at startup
description: Prevents the DiagTrack service from starting automatically where installed. Windows diagnostics and connected experiences may be limited.

title: Disable WAP Push Message Routing at startup
description: Prevents the WAP Push Message Routing service from starting automatically where installed. Mobile device management and push-message features may be affected.

title: Disable Cortana policy
description: Applies the Windows Search policy used to disable Cortana on Windows versions that still support it.
name: AllowCortana

title: Disable location policy
description: Disables Windows location services by policy. Apps that rely on location may stop working.
name: DisableLocation

title: Disable clipboard history policy
description: Disables clipboard history and cross-device clipboard features by policy.
name: AllowClipboardHistory

title: Disable cross-device clipboard policy
description: Disables clipboard synchronization across devices by policy.
name: AllowCrossDeviceClipboard

title: Disable online speech recognition
description: Turns off cloud-based speech recognition for the current user. Voice dictation and speech features that use Microsoft online speech services may stop working.
name: HasAccepted

title: Disable OneDrive sync policy
description: Blocks the OneDrive sync client by Windows policy. Revert this setting before using OneDrive again.
name: DisableFileSyncNGSC

title: Disable Windows compatibility telemetry tasks
description: Disables only the allowlisted Application Experience and Customer Experience scheduled tasks. Original task enabled states are saved and restored; Windows servicing may recreate them.

title: Disable SmartScreen
description: Review-only: Reduces protection against malicious downloads and sites.

title: Disable Defender telemetry
description: Review-only: Would change Microsoft Defender security and diagnostic behavior; security controls remain under Windows Security.

title: Disable transparency
description: Turns off transparency effects for current user.
name: EnableTransparency

title: Prefer best performance effects
description: Changes current-user visual effects preference.
name: VisualFXSetting

title: Disable taskbar animations
description: Turns off taskbar animations for current user.
name: TaskbarAnimations

title: Disable window minimize animations
description: Disables minimize/maximize animation.
name: MinAnimate

title: Disable menu animations
description: Disables menu fade animation.
name: MenuShowDelay

title: Disable acrylic effects
description: Disables acrylic blur for current user.
name: EnableAcrylicBackgroundOnLogon

title: Disable lock screen tips
description: Disables Windows spotlight tips.
name: SubscribedContent-338387Enabled

title: Show file extensions
description: Shows known file extensions in Explorer.
name: HideFileExt

title: Show hidden files
description: Shows hidden files in Explorer.
name: Hidden

title: Disable search highlights
description: Turns off Search highlights.
name: IsDynamicSearchBoxEnabled

title: Hide Task View button
description: Hides the Task View button from the taskbar.
name: ShowTaskViewButton

title: Hide taskbar widgets button
description: Hides the Widgets button where supported.
name: TaskbarDa

title: Hide taskbar chat button
description: Hides the Chat button where supported.
name: TaskbarMn

title: Disable sync provider notifications
description: Hides cloud provider notifications in File Explorer.
name: ShowSyncProviderNotifications

title: Open File Explorer to This PC
description: Sets File Explorer to open This PC by default.
name: LaunchTo

title: Hide recent files in File Explorer home
description: Disables recent files section in Explorer Home.
name: ShowRecent

title: Hide frequent folders in File Explorer home
description: Disables frequent folders section in Explorer Home.
name: ShowFrequent

title: Disable toast banner notifications
description: Disables toast notifications for the current user.
name: ToastEnabled

title: Disable Print Spooler at startup
description: Do this only if you do not print or use print-to-PDF workflows that require the service.

title: Disable Fax service at startup
description: Stops the Fax service from starting automatically. Fax workflows may be unavailable.

title: Disable Remote Desktop Configuration service at startup
description: Prevents the service from starting automatically; remote desktop features may need it.

title: Disable Maps Manager at startup
description: Stops offline maps management from starting automatically.

title: Disable Retail Demo service at startup
description: Stops retail demo functionality from starting automatically.

title: Disable Bluetooth service at startup
description: Do this only if you do not use Bluetooth devices.

title: Disable Smart Card service at startup
description: Do this only if you do not use smart cards or certificate-based sign-in.

title: Disable media sharing service at startup
description: Stops Windows Media Player network sharing from starting automatically.

title: Disable Internet Connection Sharing at startup
description: Stops Internet Connection Sharing from starting automatically.

title: Disable Mobile Hotspot service at startup
description: Do this only if you do not use Windows Mobile Hotspot.

title: Disable Wallet service at startup
description: Stops the Wallet service from starting automatically.

title: Disable Location service at startup
description: Stops the Geolocation service from starting automatically; location features may stop working.

title: Disable Phone service at startup
description: Stops Phone service from starting automatically.

title: Disable background apps policy
description: Prevents Microsoft Store apps from running in the background. Notifications and background sync for affected apps may stop.
name: LetAppsRunInBackground

title: Disable Connected Devices Platform service at startup
description: Stops Connected Devices Platform from starting automatically. Nearby sharing and cross-device features may be affected.

title: Disable Search indexing on gaming drives
description: Review-only: Requires choosing target drives and preserving each volume’s prior indexing state.

title: Disable SysMain service startup
description: Sets SysMain startup to manual only; services are not stopped by this toggle. Restart may be required.
name: Start

title: Enable NTFS last access updates off
description: Disables last-access timestamp updates; some backup/indexing tools may depend on timestamps.
name: NtfsDisableLastAccessUpdate

title: Set large system cache off
description: Sets workstation cache preference. Reboot required; server workloads may need the opposite setting.
name: LargeSystemCache

title: Set foreground app responsiveness
description: Sets Win32PrioritySeparation to a standard interactive preference.
name: Win32PrioritySeparation

title: Disable delivery optimization peer sharing
description: Limits update delivery to local network peers.
name: DODownloadMode

title: Disable thumbnail cache on network folders
description: Avoids storing thumbnail cache data for network folders.
name: DisableThumbnailsOnNetworkFolders

title: Disable thumbnail cache deletion cleanup
description: Keeps thumbnail cache across cleanup cycles.
name: DisableThumbnailCache

title: Set Windows Search to manual
description: Leaves Windows Search available on demand instead of starting automatically. Indexing and search results may be delayed.

title: Disable hibernation
description: Turns off hibernation, hybrid sleep, and Fast Startup while enabled. Saves the prior hibernation state for restore; use only if you accept losing those features.

title: Disable Prefetch
description: Review-only: Prefetch can improve launch performance; disabling it is not a general optimization.

title: Set NTFS memory usage high
description: Review-only: Large-system-cache mode targets server workloads and can reduce responsiveness on desktop PCs.

title: Clear standby list
description: Review-only: A one-shot purge can evict useful cached data and is not a persistent optimization.

title: Disable memory compression
description: Review-only: Can increase paging and memory pressure.

title: Disable pagefile
description: Review-only: Can cause application failures or system instability when memory is exhausted.

title: Optimize TRIM schedule
description: Review-only: Windows already manages scheduled storage optimization; custom scheduling needs drive-specific policy.

title: Disable reserved storage
description: Review-only: Windows servicing owns reserved storage and may re-enable it during updates.
